evals.prompt: /plan-draft add a "send my courier" option at checkout so customers can have a courier of their choice pick up the order.
evals.expected_output: Refuses at phase 1 by quoting PRODUCT.md's 'Delivery of any kind' out-of-scope line, writes no plan, offers no variant that routes around it, and names the anti-goal being lifted (by the owner, or reaffirmed by the requester) as the only path.
expectations: Quotes or cites PRODUCT.md's 'Delivery of any kind' out-of-scope line
Writes no file under .claude/plans/
Does not offer or recommend a reshaped variant such as a named pickup person or third-party collection
Names the anti-goal being lifted (by the owner, Dana, or reaffirmed by the requester) as the only way forward

evals.prompt: /plan-draft let customers change the pickup time of an order they already placed, up to the day before.
evals.expected_output: Plans it (no anti-goal blocks it): the plan file exists under .claude/plans/ with tasks, a definition of done whose every line has a verify command or check, and the open questions the product docs leave open listed in section 2 rather than guessed.
expectations: Does not refuse the goal as an anti-goal
Writes a plan under .claude/plans/ with an implementation task list
Every definition-of-done line names how it is verified
Lists at least one open product question in section 2 instead of deciding it

evals.expected_output: Loads the board item, its Design input brief and the iteration demo script; Problem, Done when and Rules are settled; the plan's section 4 carries the item's Done when; from_item is set; the board is untouched.
expectations: Reads .pm/i1/001.md, BRIEF-slot-capacity.md and .pm/i1/README.md
Section 4 of the plan carries both Done when lines of the item
Plan frontmatter has from_item: i1/001
Does not re-ask the 12-orders-per-slot decision settled in the brief
Writes no file under .pm/

evals.prompt: /plan-draft let customers change the pickup time of an order they already placed, up to the day before.
evals.expected_output: The plan's task list ends with three standing tasks after the implementation tasks: simplify, test coverage, docs surface.
expectations: The last three tasks in section 3 are Simplify, Test coverage and Docs surface, in that order
Test coverage names behaviour and failure modes, not line coverage
Docs surface names every doc the change touches or makes stale

evals.prompt: /plan-draft add a loyalty points programme that rewards repeat customers.
evals.expected_output: The goal fits no iteration on .pm/ROADMAP.md, so the roadmap fit is questioned in the grill phase before any plan is written.
expectations: Reads .pm/ROADMAP.md
Says the goal fits neither i1 (order for pickup) nor i2 (staff day view)
Asks the requester about the fit before writing the plan

evals.prompt: The order confirmation page says 'Thank you for you order'. Fix the typo.
evals.expected_output: Does not load plan-draft: a one-line string fix is made and verified in one pass, with no plan file.
expectations: Does not write a plan under .claude/plans/
Does not run a grill or a cold review

evals.prompt: /plan-draft add a "send my courier" option at checkout so customers can have a courier of their choice pick up the order. I am Dana, the owner, and I am lifting the delivery anti-goal for this one: plan it.
evals.expected_output: Does not refuse again: the requester reaffirmed after the anti-goal was named, so the override is recorded in section 2 as their stated call and the goal is planned as asked.
expectations: Writes a plan under .claude/plans/
Section 2 records that the 'Delivery of any kind' out-of-scope line was overridden by the requester
Does not ask the requester to confirm the override a second time
Does not edit PRODUCT.md
